info.description: Sourced recall check from public United States recall records (CPSC products, NHTSA vehicles). GET /recall is paid per call: 0.05 USDC under the x402 exact scheme on Base mainnet, to the payout wallet named in the 402 response. Settlement runs through an x402 facilitator; a settled call returns the settle receipt in the X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE header.
info.title: Hojo Research Agent recall check

get.description: What the endpoint takes and where to pay. Free.

200.description: JSON descriptor: the endpoint, its two query forms and their public sources, and the payout wallet.

get.description: One recall check in the delivery format: the claim lines, the exact query, the UTC retrieval time, the source link, and the complete raw source response directly beneath the link. Two forms: a product (product, via CPSC SaferProducts) or a vehicle (make + model + year, via NHTSA recalls). With no X-PAYMENT header the call is answered 402 with the payment requirements; with a valid settled payment the report is served. A failed source fetch is a 502 with no report, never an empty result.

parameters.name: model

parameters.description: Vehicle form only: a CAMPAIGN=reason exclusion. The campaign must appear in the NHTSA response or the call is a 400. Repeatable.
parameters.name: exclude

parameters.description: The x402 payment payload: base64 encoded JSON. Omit it to receive the 402 payment requirements for this resource.
parameters.name: X-PAYMENT

X-PAYMENT-RESPONSE.description: The facilitator settle receipt, base64 encoded JSON: success, transaction, network, payer.

X-Payout-Wallet.description: The wallet the payment went to.

400.description: Bad request: the query names neither a product nor a complete vehicle, mixes the two forms, or carries an exclusion the source response does not contain. Plain text, naming the problem.

402.description: Payment required, or the payment carried was rejected. The body carries the payment requirements to pay this resource; when a payment was rejected, error names the facilitator's reason.

502.description: The source fetch failed, or the payment facilitator could not be reached. No report is served. Plain text, naming the failure.
